aliases: Aurum Capital Ventures Bismarck data center
status_detail: Aurum Capital Ventures told the Burleigh County Commission in June 2025 it was considering county-owned land in east Bismarck and additional nearby state land for a data center campus; details and capacity were not disclosed.
notes: DCD cites original Bismarck Tribune reporting that Aurum was looking at roughly 300 acres of county-owned land at/near Buckstop Junction plus several hundred acres of state land. Burleigh County's 2025 planning packet separately shows county-level data-center ordinance work requiring special use/building permits for 50MW+ data centers, but the packet is regulatory context rather than a named-project approval.

aliases: Rainbow Energy Marketing Corp. Bismarck data center
status_detail: Statewide tracker record lists an operational 5 MW cryptocurrency-mining/data-center facility in Bismarck, Burleigh County; original public detail is limited.
notes: Included for completeness because statewide project trackers place a 5 MW Rainbow Energy facility in Bismarck. Rainbow's public site confirms the Bismarck corporate office but does not expose a matching facility page; treat as lower-confidence until permit/company documentation is found.

status_detail: Applied Digital announced a $3B, 280 MW AI Factory near Harwood with groundbreaking planned for September 2025, initial capacity in 2026, and full capacity in early 2027; Cass County Electric's project page says construction began September 2025.
notes: Cass County Electric says the Harwood project will peak at 280 MW and lists construction/operation/full-capacity milestones. ND PSC hearing notice identifies the Agassiz transmission/substation project as serving Cass County Electric and the large-load member Polaris Forge 2. Applied Digital later announced a 200 MW lease at the under-construction campus, with right of refusal over additional expansion potential.

status_detail: Midco markets an operating purpose-built Tier III/SOC 2 Fargo data center with 16,000 sq ft facility and more than 7,500 sq ft of raised floor.
notes: Midco source describes Fargo as one of its North Dakota data centers, with wholesale/retail colocation, Tier III uptime standards, SOC 2 compliance, redundant UPS/generators, and fiber connectivity. Public sheet gives generator specs but no reliable IT-load MW, so capacity_mw is null.

status_detail: 702 Communications markets an operating Tier 2 data center service in Fargo for storage, protection, backup, colocation/managed services, and sensitive information hosting.
notes: Official provider homepage lists Data Center as a service and states Tier 2 facility/99.8% uptime. DataCenterMap/Inflect locate the facility in Fargo and provide third-party address/capacity context; no official MW value found.

project_name: DCN Fargo Great Plains Data Center
aliases: Dakota Carrier Network Great Plains Data Center
status_detail: Dakota Carrier Network completed a more than 13,000 sq ft Tier III expansion of its existing Great Plains Data Center in Fargo in 2018; the facility continues to be listed as operational.
notes: DCN's announcement says it broke ground on the expansion in October 2017 in response to demand for secure data storage; the expansion used the same specifications as the existing Fargo Great Plains Data Center and Coleman Data Center in Bismarck. Public tracker pages locate the facility in Fargo.

status_detail: Third-party colocation directories list an operating Consolidated Communications/Fidium Fargo data center at 3312 42nd St S, Suite 100; no primary facility page was found in quick search.
notes: Included as a lower-confidence/third-party-sourced operating colocation facility because multiple data-center directories converge on the same Fargo address/operator. No official Consolidated/Fidium page was located during the quick county pass.

aliases: Stanley R. Mickelsen Safeguard Complex data center
status_detail: Governor's office announced in July 2022 that Cavalier County JDA executed binding agreements for Bitzero to acquire and redevelop the Nekoma Pyramid into a secure data center; Bitzero's 2025 network release states 2.5 MW currently available, 30 MW prepped, and up to 300 MW total capacity at the 184-acre site.
notes: Original state announcement cites CCJDA binding agreements, $500M expected investment, HPC/data-processing use, waste-heat greenhouse concept, and Bitzero's stated broader plan for 200 MW in North Dakota. Later company release updates site capacity; status marked operational because current capacity is advertised, with major expansion still planned.

status_detail: Applied Digital announced on July 1, 2026 that Phase 1 of Building 2 at Polaris Forge 1 was ready for service, bringing live capacity to 175 MW; full buildout is contracted for 400 MW critical IT load.
notes: Company and ND Commerce sources identify Applied Digital facilities in Ellendale and Harwood. Polaris Forge 1 is fully leased for CoreWeave under long-term agreements per company releases; 175 MW live as of July 2026, 400 MW contracted at full buildout.

status_detail: Applied Blockchain announced the September 8, 2022 groundbreaking of a 180 MW hosting facility in Ellendale and said it expected energization in the first half of 2023; subsequent company releases show continuing Ellendale operations.
notes: This may overlap with or be adjacent to later Polaris Forge 1 Ellendale campus records; kept as a separate historical project because the original 2022 company announcement describes a distinct 180 MW hosting facility and notes it was the company's second North Dakota facility after Jamestown.
